title: 2D functionalized copper(II)-carboxylate framework for efficient chemical fixation of carbon dioxide: insights from experimental and theoretical analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34797-34807
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04781A, Paper

H. M. Kashif Javaid, Zafar A. K. Khattak, Rizwan Ashraf, Adnan Ali Khan, Yaqoob Shah, Asim Mansha, Misbah Zia, Hussein A. Younus, Nazir Ahmad
A 2D functionalized Cu(II)-carboxylate MOF is analyzed for heterogeneous catalytic fixation of CO2 to synthesize precious cyclic carbonates. The DFT reaction mechanism is also investigated to highlight the additional role of azide functional group.
